paragraphs.text:
Your  eyes  behold  an  immense  shape  high  above  the  trees. 
Through  the  sky  it  runs,  treading  the  empty  air.  Moonlight 
picks  out  elongated,  twisted  leg  bones  and  long,  grasping 
fingers like young branches.

Make a Sanity roll: if you succeed, lose 1D10 Sanity and go to 39; if 
you fail, lose 1D100 Sanity. If you somehow avoid insanity, go to 264.
